title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

title: Cloud SysOps — Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável. 


Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.  


O Papel

Você será o operador técnico do ambiente cloud da VMetrix. Sua missão: garantir o funcionamento contínuo, estável e seguro de todos os recursos OCI em produção, qualidade e desenvolvimento. Você é a primeira linha de defesa diante de incidentes e o garantidor da disponibilidade do negócio.


Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.


Requisitos Eliminatórios — Sem exceção:

Experiência obrigatória

  • 3+ anos em operação de ambientes cloud (comprovável)
  • 2+ años trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Experiência em administração de Linux/Unix em ambientes produtivos de alta disponibilidade
  • Graduação em Engenharia de Redes, Administração de Sistemas, Infraestrutura de TI ou área correlata


OCI — Domínio operacional não negociável

  • Compute: provisionamento de VMs e BM, instance pools, autoscaling, troubleshooting de instâncias
  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Load Balancer, DNS
  • Storage: Object Storage (lifecycle, versionamento, PAR), Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage
  • IAM: compartimentos, políticas, usuários, grupos, dynamic groups, API keys
  • Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring (métricas, alarmes), Logging, Logging Analytics, Notifications
  • OCI Vault: secrets, master encryption keys, certificados
  • OCI Bastion e acesso seguro a recursos privados
  • OCI CLI e Console com fluência para operações do dia a dia


Linux/Unix — Administração avançada

  • Gestão de processos, serviços, filesystem, usuários e permissões (Oracle Linux, RHEL, CentOS)
  • Scripting bash para automação de tarefas operacionais
  • Troubleshooting de performance: CPU, memória, I/O, rede
  • Gestão de logs e diagnóstico de erros do sistema


Networking & Segurança Operacional

  • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN — conhecimento sólido
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança no SO e serviços gerenciados OCI
  • Gestão de certificados SSL/TLS e renovação programada


ITSM & Documentação

  • Gestão de incidentes, mudanças e problemas no JIRA (ou equivalente)
  • Elaboração e manutenção de runbooks e documentação técnica
  • Git básico para versionamento de scripts e documentação operacional


Perfil Diferencial - O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário, ex-contratado ou suporte técnico direto da Oracle/OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Histórico comprovado de operação de ambientes OCI críticos com SLA 99,9%+
  • Conhecimento prático de OCI Observability & Management: Logging Analytics e Operations Insights

Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)

Experience working at:

  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies

  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets

  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:

  • FX trading systems

  • Liquidity aggregation platforms

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Mobile Engineer
description:

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Analista Financeiro de Orçamento Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaboração e divulgação de relatórios com análise de resultados mensais acompanhando o real x orçado das unidades de negócios/shoppings e departamentos;
  • Apoiar a elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações;
  • Participar da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e projeções periódicas (Forecast);
  • Apoiar e participar do acompanhamento do resultado operacional (NOI), assegurando aderência ao orçamento aprovado e a avaliação de distorções;
  • Atuar com perfil analítico, visão crítica e atenção a detalhes elaborando análises financeiras, identificando variações, causas dos desvios e propondo ações corretivas quando aplicável;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com as diversas áreas da companhia, atuando de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa e orientação a resultados;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria dos controles internos, por meio da revisão de processos e implementação de automatizações, com foco na eficiência operacional e na governança dos dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização de dados serão um diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com boa capacidade de comunicação.

Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;

  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;

  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;

Descrição da vaga


SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA


A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).


Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.


Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.


Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!


ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:


  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
  • Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);

  • Gestão das relações com as partes interessadas (internas e externas).


No setor de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar na equipe do projeto, reportando-se aos Project Managers, atuando de maneira transversal entre as disciplinas nos projetos, com reporte duplo à Gerência Corporativa de Contratos e Riscos. A função atuará de forma integrativa, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão de forma multidisciplinar.

Objetivo estratégico: melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados dos projetos em questão, através da prevenção de desvios contratuais e predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.

  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Recife - PE

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Location: Dalian, China (initial phase) | Brazil Offshore (subsequent operations)

Rights to Work: Brazil

Employment Type: Contractor / Rotational


Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor to join a major offshore oil and gas project, initially based at a shipyard in Dalian, China during the construction and pre-commissioning phase, before mobilising to Brazil for offshore operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in overseeing mechanical installation, inspection, and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements.


Construction & Commissioning Phase (Dalian, China)

  • Supervise and coordinate all mechanical installation activities at the shipyard, including rotating equipment, static equipment, piping systems, and structural mechanical components
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and equipment data sheets
  • Monitor contractor and vendor progress against project schedules, flagging deviations and driving corrective actions
  • Conduct daily site walks and formal inspections, ensuring work is executed in accordance with approved procedures and specifications
  • Attend and participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) and SAT (Site Acceptance Tests) for mechanical equipment
  • Interface with QA/QC teams to ensure all mechanical work packages are correctly documented, punch-listed, and closed out
  • Liaise with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve technical queries and NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) in a timely manner
  • Support Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in preparation for sail-away


Offshore Operations Phase (Brazil)

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and operational activities in accordance with the approved maintenance management system
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA) and applicable international standards (API, ASME, ISO)
  • Lead and coordinate mechanical shutdown and turnaround activities
  • Monitor equipment condition and performance, recommending preventive and corrective maintenance strategies
  • Support HSE initiatives and enforce permit-to-work systems (PTW) at all times



Requirements

  • Mechanical supervision experience in offshore or FPSO projects
  • Proven shipyard construction experience, ideally in Asia
  • Strong background in rotating and static equipment
  • Proficiency in engineering drawings, international codes (ASME, API, ABNT), and CMMS platforms
  • Degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent trade qualification)
  • Valid offshore survival certification (OPITO/HUET); NR-10, NR-33, NR-37 required or to be obtained
  • Fluency in Portuguese mandatory; working English essential

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions

  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development

  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence

  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. title: Data Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Cloud SysOps — Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável. 


Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.  


O Papel

Você será o operador técnico do ambiente cloud da VMetrix. Sua missão: garantir o funcionamento contínuo, estável e seguro de todos os recursos OCI em produção, qualidade e desenvolvimento. Você é a primeira linha de defesa diante de incidentes e o garantidor da disponibilidade do negócio.


Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.


Requisitos Eliminatórios — Sem exceção:

Experiência obrigatória

  • 3+ anos em operação de ambientes cloud (comprovável)
  • 2+ años trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • Experiência em administração de Linux/Unix em ambientes produtivos de alta disponibilidade
  • Graduação em Engenharia de Redes, Administração de Sistemas, Infraestrutura de TI ou área correlata


OCI — Domínio operacional não negociável

  • Compute: provisionamento de VMs e BM, instance pools, autoscaling, troubleshooting de instâncias
  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Load Balancer, DNS
  • Storage: Object Storage (lifecycle, versionamento, PAR), Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage
  • IAM: compartimentos, políticas, usuários, grupos, dynamic groups, API keys
  • Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring (métricas, alarmes), Logging, Logging Analytics, Notifications
  • OCI Vault: secrets, master encryption keys, certificados
  • OCI Bastion e acesso seguro a recursos privados
  • OCI CLI e Console com fluência para operações do dia a dia


Linux/Unix — Administração avançada

  • Gestão de processos, serviços, filesystem, usuários e permissões (Oracle Linux, RHEL, CentOS)
  • Scripting bash para automação de tarefas operacionais
  • Troubleshooting de performance: CPU, memória, I/O, rede
  • Gestão de logs e diagnóstico de erros do sistema


Networking & Segurança Operacional

  • TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN — conhecimento sólido
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança no SO e serviços gerenciados OCI
  • Gestão de certificados SSL/TLS e renovação programada


ITSM & Documentação

  • Gestão de incidentes, mudanças e problemas no JIRA (ou equivalente)
  • Elaboração e manutenção de runbooks e documentação técnica
  • Git básico para versionamento de scripts e documentação operacional


Perfil Diferencial - O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário, ex-contratado ou suporte técnico direto da Oracle/OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Histórico comprovado de operação de ambientes OCI críticos com SLA 99,9%+
  • Conhecimento prático de OCI Observability & Management: Logging Analytics e Operations Insights
  • Experiência em migrações de infraestrutura para OCI
  • Familiaridade com Terraform ou Ansible para tarefas operacionais repetitivas
  • Conhecimento básico de ITIL (gestão de incidentes, mudanças e problemas)


Certificações Exigidas (ao menos uma):

  • OCI Foundations Associate (1Z0-1085)
  • OCI Operations Associate (1Z0-1067)

Altamente desejáveis:

  • OCI Cloud Operations Professional (1Z0-1067-P)
  • OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104)
  • ITIL Foundation v4
  • Oracle Linux System Administration


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix

En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.


Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix é o lugar certo.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil

Highly Desirable Skills

O que buscamos

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.
